query:
SELECT 
  email,
  name,
  CASE WHEN googleId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Google' ELSE 'Email' END as signup_method,
  emailVerified,
  createdAt,
  lastLoginAt,
  maxActions
FROM app_users
WHERE googleId IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
